Method of Attack: Callback phishing campaigns impersonating cybersecurity companies to trick victims into calling a phone number and installing remote access tools (RATs) for initial access, lateral movement, data theft, and ransomware deployment
Attack Vector: Phishing emails impersonating cybersecurity firms with callback phone numbers
Social engineering to convince victims to install remote administration tools
Indicators of Compromise: Use of AteraRMM to install Cobalt Strike
Callback phone numbers in phishing emails
